id: title:hpouillot:respect ai processing approval for severity inference

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a compliance and workflow control mechanism: checks the organization's AI data processing approval status before executing the severity inference workflow, returning a specific skip reason if not approved. This prevents unnecessary processing and potential compliance violations.
review.reason: Adds a substantive, bounded capability and its corresponding regression tests. P1.F1.H1 introduces the check and skip reason, while P1.F2.H1 adds assertions to verify the behavior. This demonstrates a correctness and reliability improvement rather than a narrow maintenance change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and test assertions. The actual production benefit, such as avoided compliance incidents or specific user benefit, is not independently verified and relies on the unverified status of the 'AI data processing approval' configuration and the actual enforcement of this check in production.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No binary/generated-only hunks. No score assigned yet.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for AI data processing approval before performing severity inference; returns a skip reason if not approved.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks the organization's AI data processing approval status before invoking the severity inference workflow, preventing unnecessary processing and potential compliance violations.
